sources.label: Wikipedia, "LP 890-9"
sources.quote: LP 890-9 is a red dwarf star located 105 light-years (32 pc) away from the Solar System in the constellation of Eridanus.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Delrez et al. 2022.

sources.label: Delrez et al. (2022), Astronomy & Astrophysics 667 A59

sources.label: Wikipedia, "LP 890-9"
sources.quote: The star has 12% the mass and 15% the radius of the Sun, and a temperature of 2,871 K. It is extremely faint and, with an apparent magnitude of 18, is the faintest star with exoplanets discovered by the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS).

color.summary: The colour of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
